name: Barangay Clearance
description: Proof of residency and good standing for job applications, NBI or police clearance, loans, bank accounts, or legal matters.

name: Barangay Business Clearance (Business Permit)
description: Required before you can get a municipal or city business permit.

name: Barangay Clearance for Building/Occupancy Permit
description: Needed for construction, renovations, or property occupancy.

name: Tricycle / Pedicab / Transport Clearance
description: For local transport operators and drivers.

name: Certificate of Residency
description: Confirms your address and how long you have lived in the barangay.

name: Certificate of Indigency
description: Verifies low income or financial hardship, for medical, financial, or educational aid such as DSWD or PCSO assistance.

name: Certificate of Good Moral Character
description: Confirms your community standing for scholarships, school enrollment, or employment.

name: First-Time Job Seeker Certification
description: Issued under Republic Act No. 11261 so you can get certain pre-employment government documents free.

name: Certificate of Solo Parent / Senior Citizen Certification
description: A prerequisite for securing official ID cards.

name: Certificate of No Objection (CNO)
description: Approves local construction, tree-cutting, events, or specific community projects.

name: Barangay Blotter Certification
description: Shows whether a person has a record or pending dispute in the barangay blotter.

name: Special Certifications
description: Varies by local need, such as live-in/cohabitation, livestock, or death/attestation records.

name: Katarungang Pambarangay Documents
description: Notice of hearing, summons, or a Certification to File Action when a dispute cannot be settled at the barangay level.

name: Barangay Protection Order (BPO)
description: Issued in cases involving domestic or gender-based safety concerns.

name: Community Tax Certificate (Cedula)
description: Often issued or coordinated through barangay or municipal treasurers.

name: Barangay Records, Data, or Certified True Copies
description: Copies of official resolutions, minutes, or barangay legislative acts.
